drafted_from: tool row in tools/keep-a-video-packaging-ledger/tool-rows.json, do-work/readback_compiled_packaging.py and the fixture of test/test_readback_compiled_packaging.py (run to observe)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that the compiled template for source key channel-fixture joins back to my packaging ledger, and write the report to out/READBACK.json." It reads the tool's row and runs readback_compiled_packaging.py on your computer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no Trillion list: the ledger is a JSON Lines file in the person's own working folder, one row per video, and the tool reads and writes files there.
instructions: 1. Build the template (TEMPLATE.json) from the projected source with tool:make-a-word-template.

2. Say which source key, ledger and compiled template to check. The AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: tool:check-a-compiled-packaging-template-against-the-ledger} and runs its `run` command; after adding videos to a source that already had a template add --before-compiled, --before-ledger and one --expected-new-video-id per added video.
3. Read the last JSON line: status pass, videos, compiled_records, legacy_preservation, ledger_prefix and output; on failure it prints {status: rejected, reason} on standard error and exits 1.
4. Tell the person pass or the reason it was rejected.
